_comment: S0558 - navigation vocabulary for the HOW_TO settings-path drift gate (scripts/quality/assert-howto-settings-paths.ps1). The settings manifest authoritatively knows setting/header labels and their destination tab, but NOT the localized display names of the tabs themselves, the Media sub-sections, or navigable screens that are not settings rows. Those live here. tabs: completeness is enforced against the manifest destination enum. mediaSubsections + allowedScreens: extend-as-needed allow-lists; a HOW_TO recipe referencing a sub-section/screen absent here fails the gate, forcing a conscious addition. Display names must match the real UI (EN/RU/UK).
